reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of both primary issuer surfaces confirms continued absence of any USDA reserve composition. (1) https://alphapartner.vip/ returned HTTP 200 as an AP U-Card marketing page; HTML and the shipped index JS contain multi-chain stablecoin/USDT top-up copy only and zero mentions of USDA, reserve composition, proof of reserves, attestation, FDIC, or itemized backing assets. Paths such as /transparency, /reserve, /reserves, and /usda serve the same SPA shell with no additional disclosure. (2) The full Alpha Partners GitBook corpus (llms.txt index plus every linked .md page: background, overview, settlement, multi-card, KYC, core features, usage guidelines, rules-and-trust, vision, roadmap, FAQ, contact, and strategy subpages) was re-fetched; none of the pages name USDA, publish reserve assets/weights/custodians/balances, or host an attestation or proof-of-reserves report. It only lists U-Card USDT top-up flows and generic platform risk language. Secondary aggregator marketing (e.g. CoinGecko/DefiLlama 1:1 USD/FDIC phrasing) is not issuer primary disclosure and supplies no itemized composition; DefiLlama auditLinks remains null. Composition therefore remains a single 100% undisclosed-reserve bucket with knownUnknownExposurePct=100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: No primary USDA reserve-composition disclosure found in the re-opened issuer website and full GitBook corpus on 2026-07-28
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All reserve asset identities, weights, obligors, custodians, legal safeguards, liquidity terms, valuation methods, and asset-versus-liability reconciliation remain unknown.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Re-opened official website and full GitBook corpus on 2026-07-28 still publish no USDA reserve source from which a composition could be authored.
